sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.18 "LTDC interrupt clear register 2 (LTDC_ICR2)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2130.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x06C
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 CCRCIF: Clear the CRC error interrupt flag
0: No effect
1: Clear the CRCIF flag in LTDC_ISR2.
Bit 6 CFUIF: Clear the FIFO underrun interrupt flag
0: No effect
1: Clear the FUIF flag in LTDC_ISR2.
Bits 5:4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 3 CRRIF: Clear register reload interrupt flag
0: No effect
1: Clear the RRIF flag in LTDC_ISR2.
Bit 2 CTERRIF: Clear the transfer error interrupt flag
0: No effect
1: Clear the TERRIF flag in LTDC_ISR2.
Bit 1 CFUWIF: Clear the FIFO underrun warning interrupt flag
0: No effect
1: Clear the FUWIF flag in LTDC_ISR2.
Bit 0 CLIF: Clear the line interrupt flag
0: No effect
1: Clear the LIF flag in LTDC_ISR2.
